forwarder_said: Arabic message: "Please cancel the furniture booking entirely, the client changed their mind."
message_to_send: Dear Sara, thank you for letting us know. We have noted your request to cancel booking B-07 (6 pieces of furniture, 1,800 kg) on FCA 201. The controller will confirm the cancellation. Kind regards, Falcon Cargo Air capacity team.
why: The Arabic message cancels the whole booking in writing, so release all 1,800 kg and 14.0 m3 (Space 3.1, 5.2). Sources: booking B-07, forwarder F-04, message T-03, Space 3.1, Space 5.2.
